meta.description: An upsell dialog in its open state on the shadcn Nova preset (Stone, Blue, radius 0). Gradient hero with a square close mark, a title-and-badge row held apart by space-between, three check-tiled feature rows in a fixed lane, and a full-width primary action with a ghost dismiss. Every value on the card reads from one token object. Static — no hooks, no motion, zero JavaScript.
